name: snowflake-cortex-code
description: Route Snowflake prompts from Codex to the local Cortex Code CLI or an opt-in managed MCP Coding Agent.

interface.shortDescription: Auto-route Snowflake prompts to Cortex Code
interface.longDescription: Automatically route Snowflake prompts to the local Cortex Code CLI or a host-authenticated managed MCP Coding Agent. Remote mode needs no local Cortex CLI; local files and per-command approval behavior differ by backend.
